Name: BetterZoom
Author: DadSaysImCool
Description:
The config file (or inside the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]) allows you to change the [b]zoom step[/b], [b]minimum[/b] and [b]maximum[/b] allowed [b]zoom levels[/b], as well as the [b]modifier key[/b] required to be held down to allow the abililty to zoom in the first place.


[size=4][b]Installation:
[/b]
[/size]Unzip the zip folder, move the unzipped folder into your mods folder, provided you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] installed. Done.

Manifest.Name: BetterZoom
Manifest.Description: Zoom in/out by scrolling up/down on your mouse wheel. Supports GMCM.
Manifest.Author: DadSaysImCool
